columns.description: Defaults to every field in definition order. Every entry must name a declared field.

pageSize.description: Local pagination within the bounded 100-record authorized window, not server cursor pagination.

bulk.description: Absent disables bulk actions. Deletion requires the generated confirmation dialog and per-record server authorization.

locales.description: Generated interface chrome. Product field and step labels are supplied by the specification.

reactive.description: True requires a server-owned trusted identity observer integration.

steps.description: Wizard only. Labels must be unique; fields across all steps must partition definition.fields exactly once. Progress defaults to memory; explicit session persistence is supported.

persistProgress.description: Wizard only for session. Stores per-user/module/context progress in sessionStorage, expires after 30 minutes, bounded to 64 KiB, schema/version checked. Cleared on logout, scope change, revocation and successful save. Owner profile only. Tenant/team/approval/master-detail persistence requires a separately reviewed server-trusted tenant context and is rejected.

title: Bounded feature UI options v1
description: Omitted options use documented defaults. Unsupported shapes fail closed. Definition-dependent checks are performed by validateUI. Explicit null is not accepted.
